dataList.name: 萬年爐火
dataList.desc: 回合結束時， [Combustion] 回數不低於3回的敵方單位額外觸發1次 [Combustion] (使其 [Combustion] 回數減少1回)

dataList.name: 盜來的火焰
dataList.desc:
Turn Start: This Gift activates for the whole Encounter when 5 or more Identities have Attack Skills that apply [Combustion] or 'Unique Burn'. (except E.G.O Skills; except Backup Units)

On Hit with a Skill(including E.G.O Skills): if the target has 3+ [Combustion] Count, activate [Combustion] once on the target. (target loses 1 [Combustion] Count; activates once per Skill)

Turn End: targets with 3+ [Combustion] Count activates [Combustion] one more time (target loses 1 [Combustion] Count)

If a target with [Combustion] is defeated(for Abnormalities, when the Core is defeated), inflict its remaining [Combustion] Potency to one of the enemies with the least [Combustion] Potency at the next Turn Start.

Turn Start: for this turn, inflict 4 [AttackDown] to enemies with [Combustion]

If a target with [Combustion] is defeated, at the next Turn Start, (defeated enemy's [Combustion] Potency / 15) allies with Skills that inflict [Combustion] gain 2 [AttackDmgUp]. (once per turn)

simpleDesc.simpleDesc: 觸發1次 [Combustion]
額外觸發1次 [Combustion]
施加陣亡單位一半的 [Combustion] 強度
施加4層 [AttackDown]
獲得2層 [AttackDmgUp]

dataList.name: 撕裂的血囊
dataList.desc: 友方單位拚點勝利時，觸發敵方單位的 [Laceration] 1次，並使敵方單位的 [Laceration] 回數減少1回(每回合最多3次)

simpleDesc.simpleDesc: 觸發1次流血(並使流血回數減少1回)

dataList.name: 出血性休克
dataList.desc:
Turn Start: This Gift activates for the whole Encounter when 5 or more Identities have Attack Skills that apply [Laceration] or 'Unique Bleed'. (except E.G.O Skills; except Backup Units)

On ally Clash Win: activate the enemy's [Laceration] once and reduce [Laceration] Count by 1 (once per turn for each ally)

Enemies become Staggerable by [Laceration] Damage; if an enemy gets Staggered due to [Laceration] damage mid-Clash, activate [Laceration] (# of remaining enemy Coins) times and reduce [Laceration] Count by (# of [Laceration] activations)

If all enemies have [Laceration], they lose 2 Defense Levels. At Turn End, inflict (# of [Laceration] activations x 2) [DefenseDown] next turn (max 20)

When inflicting [Laceration] Potency or 'Unique Bleed' with Skill effects, inflict 3 [Laceration] Potency and +1 [Laceration] Count on the target

simpleDesc.simpleDesc: 拚點勝利時，觸發敵方單位的流血 1次(並使流血回數減少1回)
拚點後，觸發敵方單位的流血 (其剩餘硬幣數)次 (並減少與觸發次數相同的流血回數)
施加(觸發的流血 次數×2)層防禦等級降低 (最多20層)
增加3級流血 強度並施加1回流血

dataList.name: 寶石振子
dataList.desc:
消耗 [Vibration] 回數的技能拚點勝利時，若目標未帶有 [Vibration] ，則對其施加2回 [Vibration] 

若包括該技能在內怠惰共鳴數不低於3，則改為施加3回 [Vibration]

simpleDesc.simpleDesc: 消耗震顫 回數的技能拚點勝利時，對目標施加2回 [Vibration]
消耗震顫 回數的技能拚點勝利且包括該技能在內怠惰共鳴數不低於3時，對目標施加3回 [Vibration]

dataList.name: 搖晃的酒桶
dataList.desc:
回合開始時，若自身的 [Vibration] 回數不低於8回，則使自身的拚點威力+1

若消耗自身的 [Vibration] 回數的技能擊殺目標或使目標陷入混亂，則對自身施加(消耗的 [Vibration] 回數/4)回 [Vibration] (每個技能最多1次)

simpleDesc.simpleDesc: 若自身的震顫 回數不低於8回，則使自身的拚點威力+1
若消耗震顫 回數的技能擊殺目標或使目標陷入混亂，則對自身施加震顫 回數

dataList.name: 震源
dataList.desc:
回合開始時，若擁有增加 [Vibration] 強度、[Vibration] 回數或施加特殊震顫的攻擊技能的友方單位不低於5名，則在本場戰鬥期間觸發該效果(不包括E.G.O技能、不包含待命人員、不包括僅擁有對自身施加 [Vibration] 回數的攻擊技能的友方單位)

消耗自身的 [Vibration] 回數的技能拚點勝利時，若目標未帶有 [Vibration]，則對其施加3回 [Vibration]

回合開始時，使自身的拚點威力+(自身的 [Vibration] 回數/5)(最多3點)

若消耗自身的 [Vibration] 回數的技能擊殺目標或使目標陷入混亂，則對自身施加(消耗的 [Vibration] 回數/2)回 [Vibration] (每個技能最多1次)

simpleDesc.simpleDesc: 消耗自身的 [Vibration] 回數的技能拚點勝利時，若目標未帶有 [Vibration] ，則對其施加3回 [Vibration]
回合開始時，使自身的拚點威力+(自身的 [Vibration] 回數/5)
若消耗震顫 回數的技能擊殺目標或使目標陷入混亂，則對自身施加震顫 回數

dataList.name: 無振八方鐘
dataList.desc:
Turn Start: This Gift activates for the whole Encounter when 5 or more Identities have Attack Skills that apply [Vibration] Potency, Count, or 'Unique Tremor'. (except E.G.O Skills; except Backup Units)
(If an Identity only has Attack Skills that gain [Vibration] Count on self, this E.G.O Gift does not activate for them)

When winning a Clash with a Skill that inflicts [Vibration] Potency or Count, or consumes [Vibration] Count on self: inflict (# of remaining Coins) [Vibration] Potency against the target and gain (# of remaining Coins) Tremor Count (max +3 Tremor Count gained per Skill). If the target does not have [Vibration], inflict +3 [Vibration] Count

Turn Start: gain (1 + ([Vibration] Count on self / 5)) [ParryingResultUp]. (max 3)

When using a Skill that consumes [Vibration] Count on self: when defeating or Staggering a target, gain ([Vibration] Count consumed / 2) [Vibration] Count (once per Skill)

Skills deal +([Vibration] consumed on self + [Vibration] Potency on the enemy + 5)% damage (except E.G.O Skills; max 50%)
When the target has [VibrationNesting], when triggering either [Switch_Vibration] or [FusionVibration] against the enemy with a type of [Vibration] they don't have in their [VibrationNesting], extend the [VibrationNesting] on target at Turn End to the next turn

simpleDesc.simpleDesc: On Clash Win, inflict Tremor equal to the # of remaining Coins. If the target does not have [Vibration], inflict Tremor Count
回合開始時，根據自身的震顫 回數相應使自身獲得拚點威力提升
若消耗震顫 回數的技能擊殺目標或使目標陷入混亂，則對自身施加震顫 回數
消耗震顫 回數的技能造成的傷害增加
回合結束時，使目標的震顫 - 疊加延長至下回合

dataList.name: 終末的碎片
dataList.desc: If the target has less than 15 [Burst] Potency, inflict 1 additional Potency when inflicting [Burst] Potency

simpleDesc.simpleDesc: Inflict 1 additional [Burst] Potency

dataList.name: 奇怪的石像
dataList.desc:
回合開始時，若擁有增加 [Burst] 強度或 [Burst] 回數的攻擊技能的友方單位不低於5名，則在本場戰鬥期間觸發該效果。(不包括E.G.O技能、不包括待命人員)

[Burst] 效果對敵方單位帶有的護盾造成的傷害+100%
若目標的 [Burst] 強度低於15級，則使其增加 [Burst] 強度時額外 +2

若技能因效果無法施加 [Burst]，則改為使該技能的硬幣威力+1
- 若是減算硬幣技能：則不獲得硬幣威力，改為獲得基礎威力 +(4 ÷ 技能硬幣數) (至少+1；無條件捨去)

simpleDesc.simpleDesc: 破裂 效果對護盾造成的傷害+100%
Inflict 2 additional [Burst] Potency
若技能因其效果不會施加 [Burst] ，則使該技能的硬幣/基礎威力增加

dataList.name: 破滅
dataList.desc:
Turn Start: This Gift activates for the whole Encounter when 5 or more Identities have Attack Skills that apply [Burst] Potency or Count. (except E.G.O Skills; except Backup Units)

[Burst] effects deal +150% damage against enemy Shield

Turn Start: enemies or Parts with [Burst] lose (3 + ([Burst] Potency / 2)) Offense Level and Defense Level. (max 6)

When inflicting [Burst] Potency or Count with Skill effects, inflict 2 [Burst] Potency and +1 [Burst] Count against the target. If the target has less than 15 [Burst] Potency, inflict 2 additional [Burst] Potency.

Coin Power +1 for Plus Coin Skills that inflict [Burst] Potency, Count, or 'Unique Rupture'
Base Power +(4 / # of Coins) (min. 1; rounded down) for Minus Coin Skills that inflict [Burst] Potency, Count, or 'Unique Rupture'

simpleDesc.simpleDesc: [Burst] 效果對護盾造成的傷害+150%
帶有 [Burst] 的敵方單位減少攻擊等級與防禦等級
透過技能效果增加 [Burst] 強度時，使目標增加2級 [Burst] 強度與1回 [Burst]
硬幣威力提升

dataList.name: 如歌
dataList.desc: 使用基礎攻擊技能時，若目標的 [Sinking] 強度不低於5級，則使自身恢復(目標的 [Sinking] 強度/10)點理智值(最多3點)

simpleDesc.simpleDesc: 根據目標的沉淪 強度相應使自身恢復理智值

dataList.name: 褪色的長大衣
dataList.desc: 回合結束時, 若理智值為-45點的敵方單位不低於3名, 則下回合使全體友方單位獲得2層 [AttackUp]

simpleDesc.simpleDesc: 使全體友方單位獲得2層 [AttackUp]

dataList.name: 浪景球
dataList.desc:
回合開始時，若擁有增加 [Sinking] 強度、[Sinking] 回數或施加特殊沉淪的攻擊技能的人格不低於5名，則在本場戰鬥期間觸發該效果(不包括E.G.O技能、不包括待命人員)

使用基礎攻擊技能時，若目標的 [Sinking] 強度不低於5級，則使自身恢復(目標的 [Sinking] 強度÷10)點理智值(最多5點)

回合結束時，每有1名敵方單位理智值為-45點，下回合使全體友方單位獲得1層 [AttackUp] (最多3層)

simpleDesc.simpleDesc: 根據目標的沉淪 強度相應使自身恢復理智值
每有1名敵方單位理智值為-45點，下回合使全體友方單位獲得1層 [AttackUp]

dataList.name: 襲來的浪潮
dataList.desc:
Turn Start: This Gift activates for the whole Encounter when 5 or more Identities have Attack Skills that apply [Sinking] Potency, Count, or 'Unique Sinking'. (except E.G.O Skills; except Backup Units)

Turn Start: inflict 1 [WaveSinking] against a random enemy

When an enemy with [WaveSinking] is killed, at the next Turn Start, transfer the [WaveSinking] Stack from the said enemy to an enemy with the highest, but not maxed, [WaveSinking] Stack

When hitting and dealing HP damage to an enemy with a Skill that inflicts [Sinking] Potency, Count, or 'Unique Sinking', inflict 4 [Sinking] Potency and +3 [Sinking] Count at Turn End (once per turn for each enemy)
Combat Start: when activating Gloom or Lust A-Reson., inflict 3 [Sinking] and +3 [Sinking] on all enemies (for Abnormalities, a random Part)

After using a base Attack Skill, if the target has 10+ [Sinking] Potency, heal ([Sinking] Potency on the target / 10) SP on self (max 5) and inflict the same amount as [DefenseDown] against the target (max 5; once per turn for each enemy)

Turn End: all allies gain [AttackUp] equal to the number of enemies that have -45 SP or are Non-SP Units next turn (max 6)

Coin Power +1 for Plus Coin Skills that inflict [Sinking] Potency, Count, or 'Unique Sinking'
Base Power +(4 / # of Coins) (min. 1; rounded down) for Minus Coin Skills that inflict [Sinking] Potency, Count, or 'Unique Sinking'

When activating the [Sinking] effect(including 'Unique Sinking') on the target with an On Hit effect from a Base Attack Skill that inflicts or gains [Sinking] Potency, [Sinking] Count, or 'Unique Sinking', heal 5 SP at Turn End (2 times per turn per Identity)
If the unit was at 45 SP at Turn Start, the effect changes to the following: when hitting and activating the [Sinking] effect(including 'Unique Sinking') on the target with a base Attack Skill, inflict +3 [Sinking] Count against the targeted enemy (2 times per turn per Identity)

simpleDesc.simpleDesc: 施加沉淪
施加防禦等級降低
獲得攻擊等級提升
恢復理智值
施加沉淪
硬幣威力提升

施加逆流

dataList.name: 天使所私
dataList.desc: 回合結束時，呼吸法 強度高於20級的友方單位消耗1級呼吸法 強度並獲得1回呼吸法

simpleDesc.simpleDesc: 消耗1級呼吸法 強度並獲得1回呼吸法

dataList.name: 桶裝烈酒
dataList.desc:
Turn Start: This Gift activates for the whole Encounter when 5 or more Identities have Attack Skills that apply or gain [Breath] Potency or Count. (except E.G.O Skills; except Backup Units)

Turn End: If an ally has more than 20 [Breath] Potency on self, the ally consumes 1 [Breath] Potency to gain 1 [Breath] Count

Turn End: 1 ally with the highest [Breath] Potency and 1 ally with the highest [Breath] Count gain 2 [Agility] and 1 [AttackUp] next turn (can activate on the same Identity)

When gaining [Breath] Potency from Skill effects, gain additional 2 [Breath] Potency and +2 [Breath] Count. If the sum of [Breath] Potency and Count on self is less than 20, gain 3 [Breath] Potency and +3 [Breath] Count instead.

Combat End: at more than 40 [Breath] Potency, consume 15 [Breath] Potency to [Discard] 1 Skill of the lowest rank in all of that unit's Skill Slots (once per turn for each character)

simpleDesc.simpleDesc: 獲得呼吸法 回數
獲得2層迅捷 與1層攻擊等級提升
透過技能效果增加呼吸法 強度時額外增加呼吸法 強度並獲得呼吸法 回數
丟棄 自身所有行動槽中級別最低的1個技能

dataList.name: 微縮電線桿
dataList.desc: 消耗自身不低於7回 [Charge] 的技能攻擊後，若擊殺目標，則使自身獲得(該技能消耗的 [Charge] 回數/4)回 [Charge] (包含特殊充能)

simpleDesc.simpleDesc: 根據消耗的 [Charge] 回數相應獲得 [Charge] 回數

dataList.name: 絕緣子
dataList.desc:
Turn Start: This Gift activates for the whole Encounter when 5 or more Identities have Attack Skills that gain [Charge] Count or 'Unique Charge'. (except E.G.O Skills; except Backup Units)

Attack End with a Skill Attack that consumes [Charge] Count on self: If the target is defeated, gain ([Charge] Count consumed by the Skill / 3) [Charge] Count

Turn Start: At less than 3 [Charge] Count, gain +3 [Charge] Count
Turn Start: At 3+ [Charge] Count, gain 1 [AttackDmgUp]

simpleDesc.simpleDesc: 根據消耗的 [Charge] 回數相應獲得 [Charge] 回數
根據 [Charge] 回數相應獲得 [Charge] 回數或1層 [AttackDmgUp]

dataList.name: 第五類永動機
dataList.desc:
Turn Start: This Gift activates for the whole Encounter when 5 or more Identities have Attack Skills that gain [Charge] Count or 'Unique Charge'. (except E.G.O Skills; except Backup Units)

Turn Start: At less than 3 [Charge] Count, gain +5 [Charge] Count.
Turn Start: At 5+ [Charge] Count, gain +2 min/max Speed, 1 [Enhancement], and 2 [AttackDmgUp]. (including 'Unique Charge')

All allies on the field gain [ShareCharge] at Turn Start.

Attack End with a Skill 3 that consumes or gains [Charge] Count on self: If the target is defeated, or if the ally who used the Skill is at 3+ [Charge], they add 1 Skill 3 to the list of Skills for the next upcoming turn. (once per turn for each ally; including 'Unique Charge')

simpleDesc.simpleDesc: 根據 [Charge] 回數相應獲得 [Charge] 回數或1層 [AttackDmgUp]
根據消耗的 [Charge] 回數相應獲得 [Charge] 回數。下回合獲得 [PlusCoinValueUp]
消耗 [Charge] 回數的3技能攻擊後，添加一個3技能到技能池中
